display_long_description:
Be the striker. Beat the defence. Score the goal.

Football: Goal Poacher brings the most exciting scoring moments in soccer to VR. Head the ball past the goalkeeper, bend free kicks around the wall, and score in front of thousands of cheering fans.

[media]

⚽ SCORE WITH YOUR HEAD

The ball comes to you. Stand in place, follow its flight, and use real head movements to direct it into the net—no running or jumping required.

Realistic ball physics make timing and placement matter. Slow-motion options also make heading easy to learn.

[media]

🥅 BEAT THE DEFENCE

Read the defenders and goalkeeper, spot the opening, and place the ball where they cannot reach it. The tougher the chance, the better the goal feels.


🎯 BEND YOUR FREE KICKS

Choose the direction and power, then move your controller to curve the ball in mid-air. Beat the wall, outsmart the goalkeeper, and find the corner.

[media]

🏟️ UNLOCK MORE STADIUMS

Keep playing to unlock new stadiums and score in front of thousands of cheering fans.

🎬 RELIVE YOUR BEST GOALS

Watch your headers and free kicks again with instant replay from multiple camera angles.

🏆 CLIMB THE GLOBAL LEADERBOARD

Score as many goals as you can, compete with players around the world, and push your name higher.

Play now and become the ultimate Goal Poacher!
